export const PROCESS = [
  { n: "01", title: "Sketch", copy: "Every piece begins on paper, in graphite, before it's ever touched metal." },
  { n: "02", title: "Carve", copy: "A wax model is hand-carved to the sketch's exact line — the master for casting." },
  { n: "03", title: "Cast", copy: "Reclaimed gold and silver are melted and cast into the wax's negative space." },
  { n: "04", title: "Set", copy: "Stones are set under magnification, one prick of the graver at a time." },
  { n: "05", title: "Polish", copy: "Hand-polished in three passes, then inspected against the original sketch." },
];
